analysis: The supplied units are base-text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines ~876-1268 and ~1268 onward). No diff hunks showing the actual PR change were provided, so I could not identify any added or removed lines. CHANGELOG.md is documentation only and has no runtime security effect. The excerpts describe SSD prefix-cache features (relevant to T-041, A-001, TB-007): encrypted SSD checkpoints, a 100 GiB default ceiling limited to half the available disk, tenant/artifact scoping, and a cache-scope allowlist. Some of these claims differ from T-041, which states available-disk/2 with no fixed ceiling, a 30-minute TTL, and an HMAC-keyed lookup. The 100 GiB wording is the base text, not a verified PR change, so I did not report it. I could not verify whether the PR changes the changelog or whether any source code changes ride with it. Other files in the PR are not visible to me. The next pass should check the corresponding source, in particular SSDPrefixCachePolicy, PrefixCachePolicy.ssdDiskBudgetBytes, and the coordinator cache_route_keys.go scope derivation, against T-041 and SEC-035. Coverage is limited to these two excerpts.
